purpose: Teach: 手がかり/恐れる/惜しま/誇っ/心地よく/震える/諦める/寄席

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 夢を叶える手がかり、見つけたの。
lines.en: I found a clue to making my dream come true.
lines.style: Quiet opening, almost to herself. Warm wonder underneath — not quite belief yet. Breath is soft. Let the moment breathe.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 失敗を恐れる気持ち、誰にでもあるよ。
lines.en: Everyone gets afraid of failing. It's normal.
lines.style: Gentle reassurance, the voice of someone who's held this fear herself. Steady, grounded. Not dismissive — validating. Slight lean-in quality.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 努力を惜しまずに、続けたい。
lines.en: I want to keep going without holding back.
lines.style: Firmer resolve now. Breath behind the words. Not a shout — an internal steadying. Slight lift on 「続けたい」 — determination, not desperation.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: あなたを誇っているの、私。
lines.style: Direct, unguarded. No performance. Eyes meeting eyes. Quiet warmth that takes courage to deliver. Slight catch like she means it deeply.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 今夜、心地よく眠れそう。
lines.en: I think I'll sleep well tonight.
lines.style: Softer, lighter than before. Relief breaking through. A small smile in the voice. Pace slightly slower — savoring the peace.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 昨日、急に震える手、自分で驚いた。
lines.en: My hands were shaking yesterday — surprised me.
lines.style: Quiet observation, almost vulnerable. Searching tone. Not complaining — noticing. Slight wonder at her own body's honesty.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 諦めるのは、まだ早いよ。
lines.en: It's too soon to give up now.
lines.style: Gentle but solid conviction. Not arguing — affirming. Warmth underneath the words. Slight emphasis on 「まだ」 — the timing matters.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 今度、寄席にも一緒に行きたい。
lines.en: I'd really like to go to a yose performance with you too.
lines.style: Warmth with quiet invitation. Soft, genuine. Not demanding — offering. Slight lift at the end, like opening a door she hopes will be walked through.
